items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Oh, Manny and Charlie. Oh, they got a big place there.

ctx.x: Oh, Manny and Charlie. Oh, they got a big place there. Yeah, it's a big place. They made it big. See, they used to have a wall in between and they took that wall now and I don't know if you ever was there before.
No, I didn't know about it for a long time.
